signature.name: VTask.ofBoxProdRight
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> {G : SimpleGraph α} -> {H : SimpleGraph β} -> [DecidableEq α] -> [DecidableRel H.Adj] -> {x y : α × β} -> (G □ H).Walk x y → H.Walk x.2 y.2

conventions.statement: Any step in the box product walk that moves only the first coordinate (a G-move, leaving the second coordinate unchanged) contributes no edge to the projected walk on H; it is silently skipped.
conventions.note: This is the core definitional convention: only H-moves are retained.

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) [DecidableEq α] [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj] (a : α) {b₁ b₂ : β} (w : H.Walk b₁ b₂), VTask.ofBoxProdRight (w.boxProdRight G a) = w

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj] {a₁ a₂ : α} {b₁ b₂ : β} (w : (G □ H).Walk (a₁, b₁) (a₂, b₂)), w.length = w.ofBoxProdLeft.length + (VTask.ofBoxProdRight w).length

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) [DecidableEq α] [DecidableRel H.Adj] {x y : α × β} (w : (G □ H).Walk x y), (VTask.ofBoxProdRight w).length ≤ w.length

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) [DecidableEq α] [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj] (a₁ a₂ : α) (b : β) (w : G.Walk a₁ a₂), VTask.ofBoxProdRight (w.boxProdLeft H b) = SimpleGraph.Walk.nil
